sourceReview.reason: Bloomingbit summarizes an October 28 Bitcoin.com article that combines a current market-size estimate with Aave's September 25 launch of seven Coinbase tokenized stocks as collateral for USDC loans on Base. The same Aave launch was already captured in publish/inbox/2026-10-20-aave-v4-becomes-top-defi-venue-for-coinbase-tokenized-stocks.json; the recap identifies no new launch, approval, financing or material expansion.
